Class SlotRendering

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.SlotRendering
public final class SlotRendering extends Object
Shared slot-rendering utility for registered slots that live outside a vanilla container texture. Used by M4 consumer code to render slot backgrounds, hover highlights, ghost icons, and items for registered MKCSlot instances.

Parallel to PanelRendering, which handles panel-level backgrounds.

Design: menukit/Design Docs/Phase 12/M4_VANILLA_SLOT_INJECTION.md.

  • Method Details

    • drawSlotBackground

      public static void drawSlotBackground(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor g, int sx, int sy, int size, boolean disabled)
      Slot background. For enabled 18×18 slots, delegates to PanelRendering.renderSlotBackground(GuiGraphicsExtractor, int, int) for vanilla-accurate visuals. For non-default sizes, falls back to PanelStyle.INSET. For disabled slots of any size, uses PanelStyle.DARK.

      public static void drawItem(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor g, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, int sx, int sy, int size, boolean dimmed)
      Renders the item centered in the slot's item area, with count and durability decorations. When dimmed=true, overlays a translucent fill to signal disabled state.
